title: Account deletion asked on another device
summary: On every signed-in device except the one that asked: a full alert while a deletion of this account waits, with "Cancelar, não fui eu" (ADR 0140). The same shape as recovery-alert.

pending.description: From GET /v1/me/account deletion, when fromThisDevice is false and the id is not dismissed on this phone.

check.effect: On launch and on foreground, with recovery-alert check: reads GET /v1/me/account and sets pending. A deletion alert waits behind a recovery alert that is shown.

cancel.effect: The device owner check (bipe_deletion_cancel_reason), then the cancel. 204 or 404: shows bipe_deletion_cancelled. Anything else: failed with bipe_error_network.

keep.effect: It was me: dismisses the alert on this phone for this request id. The deletion goes on.

notes: The alert covers the screen. It is not a banner the person can miss: a stolen, unlocked phone with the senha can ask for a deletion, and every other device can cancel for 72 hours (ADR 0140).
Cancel needs the owner check only, not the senha: the person may not have the senha at hand on the other device.
bipe_deletion_alert_body takes dueAt formatted by the system.
Dismissed ids stay on this phone only. A new request has a new id and shows again.
Bipe logic: the same model as recovery-alert (RecoveryAlertModel on iOS, RecoveryAlert.kt on Android) with the deletion as a second kind of notice.
